# What does each portion really cost, and what should you charge?

> Free recipe costing: type your pantry prices and recipes, get cost per portion, food cost percentage and the menu price that hits your target. Handles trim yield, sub-recipes, labor and packaging. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
